integrity: The continuum statement is proved analytically by separate convexity, exact vertex-orbit geometry, Jensen convexity, and a sharp two-coordinate ell_p norm comparison. The bundled checker verifies only the finite exact geometry and endpoint algebra; literature search is supporting evidence rather than a proof of global novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the real regular octagonal plane and exponents p at least one; the genuinely new branch is the modified sub-Hilbert range 1<=p<2. No classification of other polygonal norms or of 0<p<1 is claimed.
title: Sub-Hilbert modified generalized von Neumann–Jordan profile of the regular octagonal plane
